primary_expression: arithmetic mean of per-cell raw (U+S) CPM; denominator full raw U+S library; all cells incl. zeros
sensitivity_expression: raw U+S CPM on distance-observed cells
distance: cached frozen epoch11 pre-projector 1-cosine; missing stays NaN
inference: EXPLORATORY CELL-LEVEL ONLY. Independent cultures unverified; smoothing induces dependence. No confirmatory biological p/q or timing conclusion.
statistics: Welch-Satterthwaite approximation. Expression log2(mean+.01) ratio uses delta-method SE. Distance mean difference uses Welch SE. Report NHST, minimum-effect test, TOST and 90% CI.
multiple_testing: Within each readout/test, BH across all 10907 genes x 3 planned baseline contrasts; untestable/ineligible p=1. IUT joint max(p_D_min_effect,p_E_TOST) then BH same family, with stricter pair-matched and U/S joint versions. Does not fix cell dependence.
venn: Common eligible universe; E=q_expression_min_effect<.05; D=q_distance_min_effect<.05. D-only is split into expression equivalent versus inconclusive. Export conventional NHST+effect sensitivity too.
onset: First observed time meeting minimum-effect q<.05. Not detected is censored through 300min, never assigned an onset. Require eligibility at all three times for primary ordering.
stronger_early_candidate: Distance onset earlier than detected expression onset AND joint distance-change/expression-equivalence at distance onset; sensitivity requires pair-matched equivalence too.

subsampling.scope: same cohort, counts/frequencies not independent replication or biological confidence intervals

time_resolution: 0,75,150,300 min; intervals unequal. No interpolated lag or cross-correlation lead claims.
historical_preprocessing: all 839 cells jointly smoothed including later times and unstimulated controls; no prospective independence
formal_framework: Independent culture/sample identity, >=3 units/arm (power still needs planning); raw-count sample aggregation and sample-level distance; preregister margins; joint tests and held-out replication. Current formal discoveries are NOT TESTED, not zero.
